entries.title: Psalms 69:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lilies." A Psalm of David.>> Save me, O God! For the waters have come up to [my] neck.

entries.title: Psalms 69:2
segments: I sink in deep mire, Where [there is] no standing; I have come into deep waters, Where the floods overflow me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:3
segments: I am weary with my crying; My throat is dry; My eyes fail while I wait for my God.

entries.title: Psalms 69:4
segments: Those who hate me without a cause Are more than the hairs of my head; They are mighty who would destroy me, [Being] my enemies wrongfully; Though I have stolen nothing, I [still] must restore [it].

entries.title: Psalms 69:5
segments: O God, You know my foolishness; And my sins are not hidden from You.

entries.title: Psalms 69:6
segments: Let not those who wait for You, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed because of me; Let not those who seek You be confounded because of me, O God of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 69:7
segments: Because for Your sake I have borne reproach; Shame has covered my face.

entries.title: Psalms 69:8
segments: I have become a stranger to my brothers, And an alien to my mother's children;

entries.title: Psalms 69:9
segments: Because zeal for Your house has eaten me up, And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:10
segments: When I wept [and chastened] my soul with fasting, That became my reproach.

entries.title: Psalms 69:11
segments: I also made sackcloth my garment; I became a byword to them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:12
segments: Those who sit in the gate speak against me, And I [am] the song of the drunkards.

entries.title: Psalms 69:13
segments: ¶But as for me, my prayer [is] to You, O LORD, [in] the acceptable time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy, Hear me in the truth of Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 69:14
segments: Deliver me out of the mire, And let me not sink; Let me be delivered from those who hate me, And out of the deep waters.

entries.title: Psalms 69:15
segments: Let not the floodwater overflow me, Nor let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth on me.

entries.title: Psalms 69:16
segments: Hear me, O LORD, for Your lovingkindness [is] good; Turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:17
segments: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, For I am in trouble; Hear me speedily.

entries.title: Psalms 69:18
segments: Draw near to my soul, [and] redeem it; Deliver me because of my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 69:19
segments: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor; My adversaries [are] all before You.

entries.title: Psalms 69:20
segments: Reproach has broken my heart, And I am full of heaviness; I looked [for someone] to take pity, but [there was] none; And for comforters, but I found none.

entries.title: Psalms 69:21
segments: They also gave me gall for my food, And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

entries.title: Psalms 69:22
segments: ¶Let their table become a snare before them, And their well-being a trap.

entries.title: Psalms 69:23
segments: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see; And make their loins shake continually.

entries.title: Psalms 69:24
segments: Pour out Your indignation upon them, And let Your wrathful anger take hold of them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:25
segments: Let their dwelling place be desolate; Let no one live in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 69:26
segments: For they persecute the [ones] You have struck, And talk of the grief of those You have wounded.

entries.title: Psalms 69:27
segments: Add iniquity to their iniquity, And let them not come into Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 69:28
segments: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 69:29
segments: But I [am] poor and sorrowful; Let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.

entries.title: Psalms 69:30
segments: ¶I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 69:31
segments: [This] also shall please the LORD better than an ox [or] bull, Which has horns and hooves.

entries.title: Psalms 69:32
segments: The humble shall see [this and] be glad; And you who seek God, your hearts shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 69:33
segments: For the LORD hears the poor, And does not despise His prisoners.

entries.title: Psalms 69:34
segments: Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas and everything that moves in them.

entries.title: Psalms 69:35
segments: For God will save Zion And build the cities of Judah, That they may dwell there and possess it.

entries.title: Psalms 69:36
segments: Also, the descendants of His servants shall inherit it, And those who love His name shall dwell in it.
